title: Green currents of holomorphic correspondences on compact Kähler manifolds
summary: Consider a holomorphic correspondence $f$ on a compact Kähler manifold $X$ of dimension $k$. Let $1\le q\le k$ be any integer such that the dynamical degrees of $f$ satisfy $d_{q-1}<d_q$. We construct the Green currents $T_c$ of $f$ associated with the classes $c$ belonging to the dominant eigenspace for the action of $f^*$ on $H^{q,q}(X,\mathbb{R})$. We also show that the super-potential of $T_c$ is $\log$-Hölder-continuous.
